profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Fullstack | Java | Spring | REST APIs | SQL | React JS
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin, I leverage my expertise in Representational State Transfer (REST), Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), and T-SQL Stored Procedures to contribute to innovative and impactful projects. My role reflects a commitment to delivering high-quality software solutions in a collaborative and fast-paced environment.  

With a Bachelor of Science in Physics and Computer Science from The University of Texas at El Paso, I bring a strong academic foundation to my professional endeavors. Driven by an interest in integrating cutting-edge technologies such as Computer Vision and Machine Learning, I aim to explore their applications in advancing everyday processes and solutions.
